[[Jade Dragon Statuette]] is a [[trophy]] awarded for completing [[The Battle for the Jade Sea]] [[meta event]] in [[Dragon's End]] for the week. It is one of four statuettes in [[The Jade Vault]] [[collection]], and can be traded with [[Myung-Hee]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]] once a week for a [[Bounty of Dragon's End]].
